description: Java class implementing a Thrift client for Hive CLI service, providing methods to manage sessions, execute statements, fetch results, and handle delegation tokens via Thrift RPC calls.

classes.name: ThriftCLIServiceClient
classes.description: Java class that acts as a client for Hive's Thrift-based CLI service, enabling session management, query execution, and result retrieval.

methods.name: checkStatus
methods.description: Checks the status of a TStatus object and throws HiveSQLException if the status indicates an error.

methods.name: openSession
methods.description: Opens a new Hive session with specified username, password, and configuration.

methods.name: openSessionWithImpersonation
methods.description: Throws exception as impersonation is not supported in this client.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about the session based on GetInfoType.

methods.name: executeStatementInternal
methods.description: Internal method to execute a statement with options for async execution and timeout.

methods.name: getOperationStatus
methods.description: Checks the status of an operation.

methods.name: getResultSetMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a result set.

methods.name: fetchResults
methods.description: Fetches results for an operation with specified orientation, max rows, and fetch type.

methods.name: getDelegationToken
methods.description: Obtains a delegation token for the session.

methods.name: getPrimaryKeys
methods.description: Retrieves primary keys for a table.

methods.name: getQueryId
methods.description: Retrieves the query ID for an operation.
